title: P4: Expand CommandPalette action set
description: CommandPalette currently only supports page navigation. Add actions for common operations: create mission, create workflow, toggle theme, open settings, view notifications. Source: heuristic-eval, information-architecture.

title: P3: Collapse LeftNav to icon rail on Live View entry
description: Plan calls for nav to collapse to 48px icon-only rail during Live View instead of disappearing entirely. Preserves minimal navigation access. Sources: plan Phase 5.

title: P2: Add failure reason display for failed agent sessions
description: When an agent session fails, no dedicated error summary or stack trace is visible. Add FAILURE REASON section to AgentSwimlane with error details and Restart Session button. Sources: user-journeys J7, heuristic-eval H9-02.

title: P3: Add confirmation step to Agent Launch
description: LAUNCH AGENT button fires immediately with no confirmation. Add brief summary and Confirm/Cancel step before launching (max tokens can be 200K). Sources: heuristic-eval H5-02.

title: P2: Add inline code diffs to DiffByIntent on Review page
description: DiffByIntent shows file paths and line counts but no actual code diffs. Add expandable inline diff views per file so reviewers can verify agent work at code level. Sources: user-journeys J5, cognitive-walkthrough J5.

title: P3: Add per-agent status indicators in Live View header
description: Live View header should show each agent's current status (idle/working/blocked/error) so users can see agent health at a glance without scrolling through chat logs. Source: cognitive-walkthrough, state-model.

title: P4: Fix setTimeout shadowing in AgentConfigPanel
description: AgentConfigPanel uses setTimeout in a way that shadows or leaks timers. Clean up timer management to prevent potential memory leaks. Source: failure-path-audit.

title: P3: Add color-coded status indicators to Terminal/Browser sessions
description: Terminal and browser sessions show status as text-only with no color differentiation. Add colored dots matching AgentSession convention (green=active, amber=idle, gray=completed, red=failed). Sources: state-model R3.

title: P3: Add onboarding or help system for first-time users
description: No onboarding, tooltips, or help system exists for the metaphor-heavy UI. First-time users receive zero explanation of what Mission, Workflow, Stage, or Escalation mean. The military/tactical aesthetic signals purpose but may alienate. Add brief onboarding tooltip or What is Mission Control explanation without abandoning the metaphor. Sources: Heuristic Eval, Cognitive Walkthrough.

title: P2: Standardize success feedback patterns
description: Five different feedback patterns: toast, nothing, label change, inline text, no feedback. Adopt the MissionCreate toast pattern system-wide for all mutating actions. Sources: consistency-audit Inv 12.

title: P1: Add form validation to MissionCreate and WorkflowCreate
description: Both create forms accept entirely empty submissions and show success toasts. Zero validation on any field. Add required field marking, empty submission prevention, inline error messages. Also add disabled HTML attribute to ApprovalBar Approve button when canApprove is false (currently CSS-only, still clickable). Sources: Failure Path Audit, Heuristic Eval, Cognitive Walkthrough.

title: P2: Complete Workspace entity dissolution
description: Remove Workspace.tsx page, rename components/workspace/ to components/live-view/, remove workspaces.find() fallback in LiveView.tsx, remove WorkspaceTabs.tsx. The deprecated entity creates a ghost concept. Sources: conceptual-model R2, glossary P1, plan Phase 3.

title: P2: Decouple escalation from stage lifecycle (make overlay)
description: Escalation is modeled as a mutually exclusive stage but should be a concurrent overlay. A mission in execute stage should be able to have an active escalation without leaving execute. This is the deepest conceptual model ambiguity - affects data model, routing, and Kanban board. Sources: Conceptual Model, Vocabulary Audit, State Model.

title: P1: Adopt EmptyState component everywhere (delete 7 ad-hoc patterns)
description: The EmptyState primitive in components/primitives/EmptyState.tsx is never imported anywhere. Seven different ad-hoc empty state patterns exist across the app with different typography, padding, and structure. Adopt EmptyState for: EvidenceRail filtered view, NotificationCenter empty dropdown, Workflows page zero workflows, WorkspaceLayout empty quadrants, AgentChatPanel zero sessions, MissionHome differentiating no-match vs no-missions. Sources: Consistency Audit, Failure Path Audit.

title: P1: Wire TopBar search icon to CommandPalette
description: The onOpenCommandPalette prop exists on TopBar but is never passed from AppShell. The search icon is a broken affordance visible on every page. Only Ctrl+K opens CommandPalette. Wire the click handler. Sources: Heuristic Eval, Cognitive Walkthrough, Journey Map.

title: P3: Add workflow assignment dropdown to MissionCreate form
description: No way to assign a mission to a workflow during creation. Add optional workflow dropdown to the create form. Sources: user-journeys J2.

title: P4: Standardize padding and rail widths across panels
description: Side panels, rails, and content areas use inconsistent padding and width values. Establish standard spacing tokens and apply them uniformly. Source: consistency-audit.

title: P0: Wire critical button handlers (ApprovalBar, MissionCreate, Pause/Play)
description: 3/7 core journeys dead-end at non-functional buttons. ApprovalBar approve/reject/re-plan have no onClick. MissionCreate handleCreate only toasts with no navigation. AgentChatPanel Pause/Play does nothing (sev-4 usability catastrophe). Wire mock implementations so journeys complete. Sources: Journey Map, Heuristic Eval, Cognitive Walkthrough.

title: P4: Rename OVERVIEW toggle label on MissionDetail
description: The 'OVERVIEW' toggle label is unclear — it doesn't communicate what it toggles between. Rename to something more descriptive like 'Details' / 'Summary'. Source: vocabulary-audit.

title: P3: Compute verificationState from evidence instead of denormalizing
description: Replace manually-maintained verificationState field with computed derivation from evidence items. Denormalized field drifts and misleads. Sources: state-model R5.

title: P4: Add helper text to AgentConfigPanel fields
description: AgentConfigPanel form fields lack helper text or tooltips explaining what each configuration option does. Add descriptive helper text. Source: heuristic-eval, cognitive-walkthrough.

title: P0: Add horizontal stage tab bar to all mission sub-pages
description: The four-stage lifecycle (Plan/Execute/Review/Escalation) is the core product concept but has no persistent tab bar UI. Users must scroll past 8+ sections on MissionDetail to find buried text links at the page bottom. Create a StageTabBar component and render on all mission sub-pages (MissionDetail, MissionPlan, MissionExecute, MissionReview, MissionEscalation). Sources: Cognitive Walkthrough, Info Architecture, Heuristic Eval.

title: P4: Fix frozen timestamp in AppShell header
description: AppShell displays a static timestamp that never updates. Either make it a live clock or remove it — a frozen time display is misleading. Source: consistency-audit.

title: P3: Add notification badge to Live View mode
description: Live View exits AppShell entirely, severing access to NotificationCenter. New notifications during supervision are invisible. Add a notification badge or ambient indicator to Live View header so escalations surface during supervision. Must balance calm-by-default philosophy with escalation visibility. Sources: Journey Map, Cognitive Walkthrough.

title: P3: Add empty panel states to WorkspaceLayout (Live View)
description: When browser/terminal sessions are undefined, Live View renders empty white rectangles. Add placeholder messages explaining no session is active. Sources: failure-path-audit.

title: P3: Standardize evidence status display labels (tense consistency)
description: Evidence uses pass/fail (result tense), modals use Passing/Failing (progressive), summaries use WARN (abbreviation). Standardize on result tense for evidence, progressive for verification state. Sources: glossary P4.

title: P4: Add RiskBadge to History page entries
description: History page shows mission events but doesn't display risk level badges. Add RiskBadge to history entries for at-a-glance risk awareness. Source: information-architecture.

title: P4: Add sort options to MissionHome list view
description: MissionHome only supports filtering by stage but not sorting (by date, risk, priority, name). Add sort dropdown with common sort options. Source: information-architecture.

title: P3: Surface Mission.priority field or remove it
description: Priority is populated on every mission but never rendered. Either add PriorityBadge component or remove the field entirely. Sources: conceptual-model R3, state-model R7.

title: P2: Standardize primary action button colors and acceptance criteria rendering
description: Primary action buttons use 3 different background colors (aw.accent, aw.plateDark, semantic.success). Acceptance criteria rendered 4 different ways across pages (CheckCircle icons, colored dots, bull chars at two sizes). Standardize both to single patterns. Sources: Consistency Audit.

title: P2: Add unsaved-changes navigation guard to create forms
description: Both MissionCreate and WorkflowCreate lose all input on accidental navigation. Add beforeunload handler or router blocker plus Cancel/Discard button. Sources: user-journeys J2, failure-path-audit, consistency-audit.

title: P3: Separate blockers from warnings in ApprovalBar
description: ApprovalBar mixes blocking issues and warnings in the same display. Separate them so users can quickly see what actually prevents approval vs. what's advisory. Source: cognitive-walkthrough, consistency-audit.

title: P4: Show blocker details inline in ApprovalBar
description: ApprovalBar shows that approval is blocked but doesn't explain why. Display the specific blockers (e.g., 'Missing 2 evidence items', 'Tests failing') inline so users know what to fix. Source: cognitive-walkthrough.

title: P4: Show tool call summaries in AgentChatPanel
description: AgentChatPanel shows agent messages but doesn't surface tool call summaries (file reads, writes, test runs). Add collapsible tool call indicators so users can see what the agent is doing. Source: cognitive-walkthrough, conceptual-model.

title: P4: Disambiguate dual-URL mission access patterns
description: Missions accessible at both /missions/:id and /workflows/:wfId/missions/:id may cause confusion. Ensure breadcrumbs and back-navigation differ correctly for each URL context. Source: information-architecture.

title: P1: Fix step.status === success bug in MissionExecute
description: MissionExecute.tsx line 234 checks step.status === success but AgentStep type defines completed/running/pending/failed. The success value does not exist so the checkmark indicator never renders. Change to completed. Independently confirmed by Vocabulary Audit and State Model agents.

title: P4: Add filter summary text to MissionHome
description: When filters are active on MissionHome, there is no summary text showing what filters are applied. Add a visible filter summary (e.g., 'Showing 3 of 8 missions filtered by: Stage=Execute'). Source: heuristic-eval.

title: P2: Add real-time current-step indicator in agent swimlanes
description: No pulsing or highlighted indicator shows which step an agent is currently on. Add distinct current step marker and progress fraction (e.g. Step 5/12). Also add per-agent status chips in Live View header. Sources: heuristic-eval H1-01, H1-04.

title: P0: Add ErrorBoundary wrapping Outlet in AppShell and Live View
description: No React ErrorBoundary exists in the component tree. A single runtime error crashes the entire app to a white screen. Wrap Outlet in AppShell and Live View root with ErrorBoundary showing Something went wrong plus Back to Missions link. Sources: Failure Path Audit, Heuristic Eval.

title: P2: Add AgentSession lifecycle controls (pause/resume/retry)
description: AgentSwimlane displays session status but provides no interactive controls. Add pause/resume/retry buttons to failed and paused sessions. Sources: state-model R4, user-journeys J7.

title: P3: Add visible close button to Live View and guard Esc key
description: Live View exit relies on subtle Back text link and Esc key. Add prominent close/exit button icon. Also guard Esc handler to check for open modals/inputs first. Sources: heuristic-eval H3-04, cognitive-walkthrough J3.

title: P2: Add completed terminal state to Mission Stage type
description: The Stage type is plan/execute/review/escalation with no completed/done/cancelled state. The Approve button has no handler and no target state. Without a terminal state, no mission can finish, no workflow can complete, and History is meaningless. Add completed to Stage union, CompletedBadge variant, and transition logic from review to completed. Sources: State Model, Conceptual Model.

title: P2: Add in-app toast notifications for escalations
description: Escalation notifications are passive badges only. Add push-style toast that surfaces even during Live View supervision mode. Sources: cognitive-walkthrough J4.

title: P2: Persist escalation decisions (not just useState)
description: Escalation resolution is managed entirely through ephemeral React useState in ConsequencePanel.tsx. Refreshing the page resets all decisions. Confirmed decisions do not cascade to update parent Mission stage. Move state to data model so decisions survive refresh and cascade properly. Sources: State Model, Journey Map.

title: P4: Fix MED abbreviation to MEDIUM in risk badges
description: Some risk badges display 'MED' instead of the full 'MEDIUM' label. Standardize to use the full word everywhere for consistency with HIGH/LOW/CRITICAL. Source: vocabulary-audit, consistency-audit.

title: P4: Standardize section label casing (sentence vs ALL CAPS)
description: FocusPanel uses sentence case for section labels while all other panels use ALL CAPS. Pick one convention and apply it everywhere. Source: consistency-audit.

title: P2: Add transition feedback for state changes (toasts/animations)
description: No toast, animation, or visual feedback when missions transition between stages or when users trigger state changes. Add transient feedback for every user-triggered state transition. Sources: state-model R10.

title: P4: Fix event type hyphen display in notification/event lists
description: Event type labels display with raw hyphens (e.g., 'stage-change') instead of human-readable format. Format event types for display. Source: vocabulary-audit.

title: P2: Standardize approval/action placement across stages
description: Plan approval is buried at page bottom while Review uses a sticky top bar. Escalation ConsequencePanel is in a right rail. Adopt ApprovalBar sticky-top pattern for all stages with stage-appropriate CTAs. Sources: info-architecture R2.

title: P4: Add keyboard shortcuts for common actions
description: Beyond Ctrl+K for CommandPalette, no keyboard shortcuts exist for common actions like approve, reject, navigate between missions, or toggle Live View. Add shortcuts and document them. Source: heuristic-eval, cognitive-walkthrough.

title: P3: Make Live View breadcrumb mission title a clickable link
description: Mission title in LiveViewHeader is a span not a Link. Make it navigate to mission overview for easy navigation without exiting to Execute first. Sources: info-architecture R5.

title: P3: Fix Session overload on MissionExecute page
description: Three meanings of session on one page: Agent Sessions, Browser/Terminal sessions, SESSIONS section header. Rename SESSIONS section to TOOL PANES or ACTIVE TOOLS. Sources: glossary P2.

title: P4: Fix Settings page SelectControl behavior
description: Settings page SelectControl may not properly reflect saved values or may not persist selections. Verify and fix the select control state management. Source: consistency-audit, failure-path-audit.

title: P4: Add CommandPalette keyboard shortcut hints
description: CommandPalette results don't show keyboard shortcut hints for common actions. Add shortcut badges next to items that have keyboard shortcuts. Source: heuristic-eval.

title: P4: Remove stale Inbox breadcrumb reference
description: A breadcrumb or navigation element still references 'Inbox' which doesn't exist as a page or concept in the current system. Remove the dead reference. Source: information-architecture.

title: P3: Add VerificationBadge to Kanban board cards
description: WorkflowDetail MissionBoardCard shows RiskBadge but not VerificationBadge. Missions with failing verification look identical to passing ones on the board. Sources: conceptual-model R8, consistency-audit.

title: P4: Govern decorative element usage (corner brackets, pins, scanlines)
description: Decorative elements (CornerBracket, PanelPins, FeedTicks, scanlines) are applied inconsistently across pages. Create usage guidelines and audit all pages for consistent application. Source: consistency-audit.

title: P3: Add LIVE indicator badge on MissionCards for active missions
description: MissionHome cards do not indicate which missions have active live agent activity. Add badge for execute-stage missions with active agents. Sources: user-journeys J3.

title: P4: Add h1 heading to pages missing it
description: Several pages lack a visible h1 heading, which hurts accessibility and screen reader navigation. Ensure every page has a proper h1. Source: information-architecture, heuristic-eval.

title: P3: Fix not-found states to preserve shell navigation
description: MissionPlan, MissionExecute, MissionReview, and MissionEscalation render not-found states without TopBar or PageTransition, stranding users with no navigation context. MissionDetail and WorkflowDetail correctly preserve the shell. Standardize all not-found states to include TopBar and back navigation. Sources: Consistency Audit.

title: P2: Make History and Costs pages link to missions
description: History and CostDashboard are dead-end pages with no outbound links to missions despite displaying mission data. Add Link components so mission IDs and names navigate to mission detail. Sources: Info Architecture, Cognitive Walkthrough.

title: P3: Differentiate LOW and MEDIUM risk badge colors
description: LOW RISK and MEDIUM RISK badges are near-identical visually - backgrounds differ by approximately 10-15 RGB values in the gray spectrum (haze vs lineFaint). Users cannot distinguish them at a glance. Use more distinct colors or add secondary visual cues. Sources: State Model, Consistency Audit.

title: P3: Allow selecting which escalation to act on
description: When multiple escalations exist, the user cannot choose which one to address. Add selection mechanism so users can pick and act on specific escalation items. Source: cognitive-walkthrough, state-model.

title: P3: Fix CostDashboard Math.max runtime bug with zero sessions
description: Math.max(...[]) returns -Infinity when no sessions exist, causing incorrect bar width calculations. Add proper empty-state handling. Sources: failure-path-audit.

title: P3: Differentiate notification urgency by icon color
description: All notification type icons render in same gray. Change to type-specific: red for escalation/failure, blue for evidence, green for approval, gray for stage-change. Sources: state-model R8.

title: P4: Add Escape-to-close for overlay panels and modals
description: Overlay panels (CommandPalette, NotificationCenter, modals) don't consistently close when Escape is pressed. Add uniform Escape key handling to all overlays. Source: heuristic-eval.

title: P3: Enforce or clarify dependency constraints
description: blockedBy/blocks relationships are displayed but not enforced. Either prevent blocked missions from advancing past plan, or clearly label dependencies as informational only. Sources: conceptual-model R6.

title: P3: Add undo/grace period for escalation decisions
description: After confirming an escalation option, no undo exists. Add time-limited undo (30 seconds) before decision becomes permanent. Sources: heuristic-eval H3-03, cognitive-walkthrough J4.

title: P1: Route notifications to stage-specific pages
description: NotificationCenter.handleClick navigates every notification to /missions/missionId (overview) regardless of type. Escalation alerts should route to /escalation, agent failures to /execute, approval requests to /review. Saves 2+ clicks per notification task. Sources: Journey Map, Info Architecture, Cognitive Walkthrough.

title: P3: Fix back-arrow inconsistency on stage sub-pages
description: Back arrows on Plan/Review/Escalation navigate to list page, skipping mission overview. Should navigate to mission overview (parent in zoom hierarchy). Sources: info-architecture R3.
